blocks.orig: Kiriche Luxury Camp sits along the Warangi River in Serengeti National Park, which makes it a comfortable and intimate stay in the middle of Tanzania’s wilderness. The camp has 7 spacious ensuite tents and a family tent with two rooms and a lounge. All tents feature raised platforms, hot and cold water showers, flushing toilets, and verandas with river views. Meals range from continental breakfasts to bush barbecues under the stars, while the full bar tent serves cocktails with a view of the surroundings. A fireplace pit adds warmth to cool nights, and WiFi in the main tent keeps you connected!
blocks.html: On the banks of the Warangi River in Serengeti National Park lies Kiriche Luxury Camp, a comfortable and intimate place to stay in the heart of Tanzania’s wilderness. It has 7 roomy ensuite tents, plus a family tent with two rooms and a lounge. Every tent stands on a raised platform and has hot and cold showers, flushing toilets and a veranda overlooking the river. Meals vary from continental breakfasts to bush barbecues beneath the stars, and the fully stocked bar tent serves cocktails with views of the area. On cool nights a fire pit keeps you warm, and WiFi in the main tent means you can stay connected!
